opening.argument: The video demonstrates SafePal’s Polygon wallet functions: the speaker introduces how to use Polygon in the wallet, the asset list shows POL, and the POL screen displays Swap, Receive, and Send controls. Those visible steps support an instructional purpose centered on viewing and using the wallet, rather than a deceptive mechanism. The separate Binance, Bitget, and Bitunix promotions are identified as affiliate links in the description, which also warns that cryptocurrency investments can result in the loss of an entire investment. On the available evidence, those promotions are contextual advertising alongside the wallet demonstration.
